purpose: Prevent generator/evaluator contamination in editorial-intelligence image benchmarks.
rules: Generate control and experimental candidates in separate executor calls.
Each generation call sees only its own semantic brief and prompt contract.
Do not expose candidate labels such as control, compiled, Campo Grafico, Italian, score, winner or judge to either generation call unless the prompt itself legitimately requires those words.
Freeze both generated artifacts before evaluation.
Anonymize candidates as X and Y before Aesthetic Judge receives them.
Aesthetic Judge receives the semantic brief and acceptance rubric, but not which prompt produced which candidate.
Judge records beauty, editorial intentionality, semantic-content/form relation, hierarchy, material justification, non-template behavior and failure reasons.
Only after judgement may provenance be reattached.
Self-scores or captions emitted by the image model never count as evaluation evidence.
A failed or contaminated run is preserved as Experience/Rejection Memory and must not modify historical Evidence Memory.
pass_condition: The pair was generated independently, judged blind, provenance was reattached only after judgement, and the record contains no evaluator leakage into generation.
capability_effect: None by itself. This protocol only makes later transfer evidence admissible.
